name: Sudal Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Sudal Industries Ltd is a manufacturer and supplier of Aluminum based Products.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company manufactures Aluminum Extrusions and Aluminum based Alloys. Products are made by melting of Aluminum Ingots into Alloy Billets and further extruded to manufacture extrusions.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.0% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 82.3% of their holding.
